messages:
Marta: Heads-up — planning to roll realtime_v2 feature flag to 5% canary in prod at 10:30 PT. Will start gradual ramp if latency and error rate stable. Need clarity on kill-switch ownership & audit trail. @chris @samir

Chris: got it. Who is allowed to flip the flag emergency-off? Ops runbook lists 'oncall' + SRE leads but want explicit name for this rollout.

Samir: per docs, runbook section 'feature-emergency-flips' says: oncall -> SRE lead -> EngManager. But in practice oncall can flip; need a second ack for audit. I can be the SRE lead on-call for this shift.

Marta: ok cool. Two asks: 1) Can oncall flip immediately if P50 latency > 200ms or error-rate delta > 2%? 2) What exact command/portal and where does audit log end up?

Jen: For this feature, primary guardrail is 95th latency and 5xx rate. We monitor /metrics/realtime_v2/errors and /traces/service=realtime. If thresholds breached, flip to 0% and failover to realtime_v1.

Chris: Command to flip (CLI):
``
redwood flags set realtime_v2 --percent=0 --reason="auto-rollback:latency" --by=@oncall
```
Portal: https://console.redwood.ai/flags/realtime_v2 -> Edit -> Emergency Off

oncall-bot: NOTE: All flag changes require a short reason and are recorded in audit-log at s3://redwood-audit/flags/YYYY/MM/DD/{flag_change_id}. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/feature-flags

Samir: small checklist for whoever flips: 1) post in #eng-oncall with reason 2) ping @chris 3) attach flag_change_id in incident ticket 4) run smoke test `curl -s https://prod.realtime/health | jq .` and paste results.

Marta: I'll be the primary flipper if needed; Samir will be verifier. Chris will monitor. If no ack within 5m escalate to EngManager (Jen).

Chris: I'll set a monitor alert panel for the rollout and keep zoom open. :thumbsup:

Jen: make sure to tag the PR with `ops-approved` so we have ownership trace.

Marta: thanks. Will post start + percent in this thread when rolling. 

oncall-bot: ACTION_LOG: schedule=1758006000, actor=marta, planned_change=realtime_v2->5%, monitor=alerts/realtime_v2_canary
